cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Could you cancel our anniversary table? The restaurant number's on the fridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Please let the call be the first thing you take off me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call. They might ask whether you want another date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say no for me. Then stay while I put the anniversary glasses away. You can tell me about your day.
